sloka: अम्ब केन अत्यगात् राजा व्याधिना मय्य् अनागते ।धन्या राम आदयः सर्वे यैः पिता सम्स्कृतः स्वयम् ॥२-७२-२९॥
transliteration: amba kena atyagāt rājā vyādhinā mayy anāgate ।dhanyā rāma ādayaḥ sarve yaiḥ pitā samskṛtaḥ svayam ॥2-72-29॥

translations.english: O mother what ailment caused the king's death before I could return? How fortunate are Rama and others by whom the last rites of my father were performed
